claims: As of April 11, 2026, Shane Lowry has recorded multiple professional holes-in-one.
Shane Lowry is the first player in history to hit two aces at Augusta National during the Masters.
Shane Lowry aced the 16th hole in the final round of the 2016 Masters.
Shane Lowry used an 8-iron from 181 yards for his ace on the 16th hole in the 2016 Masters.
Shane Lowry aced the 17th hole at TPC Sawgrass in the 2022 The Players Championship.
Shane Lowry aced the 7th hole in the 2024 AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am.
Shane Lowry aced the second hole at Memorial Park Golf Course in the 2026 Texas Children's Houston Open in March 2026.
Shane Lowry aced the 6th hole in the third round of the 2026 Masters on April 11, 2026.
Shane Lowry used a 1-iron from 190 yards for his ace on the 6th hole in the 2026 Masters.
Shane Lowry's 2026 Masters ace was on Saturday.
Shane Lowry's 2026 Masters ace moved him into contention during the third round.
Shane Lowry is the 7th player all-time to ace the 6th hole at Augusta National
